resources.string: Connect your device using the desktop app or CLI.
For the best experience on Windows or macOS, connect using the desktop app.
Connect your device with a single command. Suggested for Linux.
Download the Agents Anywhere desktop app from the official download page, then follow the steps below to connect.
Choose the Windows or macOS installer for your device on the official download page, then download and install it.
Open the app and sign in
Open the desktop app, connect to the service you are using here, and sign in with the same account.
Wait for your device to connect
After sign-in, the desktop app connects this device automatically. Return to this app to find and use it in the Devices list.
This method requires some technical experience. You should be comfortable using the terminal and uv / uvx command-line tools.
On Windows or macOS, we recommend the desktop app for easier setup and everyday use.
Give your device a recognizable name, then choose a pairing method.
Choose how to connect %1$s to your account.
Run a command on your device, then enter the generated 6-digit pairing code here.
Run a command containing a token on your device to connect directly.
Run this command in the terminal on %1$s to connect it to your account automatically.
Keep the terminal running. Closing it takes your device offline. On Linux, you can use screen to keep the session running in the background:
Once your device is online, press Ctrl-A then D in screen to detach while keeping it running. To return to the session, run:
Waiting for device to come online...
Enter the pairing code from %1$s below to finish connecting.
Run the command, then enter the 6-digit pairing code shown in the terminal below.
The device %1$s has been created but is not yet paired. If you no longer need it, please delete it manually from the Devices list.
Copy failed. Please select the command and copy it manually.
Pairing will keep waiting for %1$s to come online after you leave this page and update the Devices list. If you no longer need this device, delete it from the Devices list.
